meta.name: Liberation through Renunciation
meta.outline: Verses 1–12: renunciation and letting go, and the three kinds of letting go; 13–18: the five causes of every action; 19–28: three kinds of knowledge, of action and of doer; 29–35: three kinds of understanding and of steadiness; 36–40: three kinds of happiness; 41–48: the duties born of each person's nature, and one's own work as worship; 49–56: from perfection to Brahman, and on to devotion; 57–66: the final teaching, to take refuge in Krishna alone; 67–72: who should be taught this, and what comes of studying it; 73: Arjuna's answer; 74–78: Sanjaya's closing words.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
words: I wish to know the truth about renunciation
verses.tr: Arjuna said: Krishna, I wish to know the truth about renunciation, and also about letting go, and how the two differ.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः
words: giving up actions done out of desire
giving up the results of all actions
verses.tr: Krishna said: The sages understand renunciation as giving up actions that are done out of desire. The wise call the giving up of the results of all actions letting go.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: त्याज्यं दोषवत् इति एके कर्म प्राहुः मनीषिणः
some thinkers say that action should be given up as a fault
यज्ञ-दान-तपः-कर्म न त्याज्यम् इति च अपरे
others say that acts of sacrifice, giving and discipline should not be given up
verses.tr: Some thinkers say that all action is flawed and should be given up. Others say that acts of sacrifice, giving and self-discipline should not be given up.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: निश्चयं शृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम
words: hear my conclusion about letting go
for letting go is said to be of three kinds
verses.tr: Hear my conclusion about letting go, Arjuna. Letting go is said to be of three kinds.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: acts of sacrifice, giving and discipline should not be given up
verses.tr: Acts of sacrifice, giving and self-discipline should not be given up. They should be done, for sacrifice, giving and discipline purify the wise.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च
words: giving up attachment and the results
this is my firm and final view
verses.tr: But even these actions should be done without attachment and without a claim on their results. This, Arjuna, is my firm and final view.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: नियतस्य तु कर्मणः संन्यासः न उपपद्यते
it is not right to give up one's required duty
giving it up out of delusion
is said to be of dullness
verses.tr: It is not right to give up one's required duty. Giving it up out of delusion is said to be of dullness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत्
words: दुःखम् इति एव यत् कर्म त्यजेत्
whoever gives up an action just because it is painful
out of fear of bodily trouble
having let go in the way of passion
does not gain the reward of letting go
verses.tr: Whoever gives up a duty just because it is painful, or out of fear of bodily trouble, lets go in the way of passion and gains none of the reward of letting go.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः
words: कार्यम् इति एव यत् कर्म नियतं क्रियते
when a required duty is done just because it ought to be done
giving up attachment and also the result
that letting go is held to be of goodness
verses.tr: But when a required duty is done simply because it ought to be done, Arjuna, without attachment and without a claim on the result, that letting go is held to be of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: and is not attached to pleasant work
the one who lets go, filled with goodness
verses.tr: The one who lets go, filled with goodness, wise and free from doubt, does not hate unpleasant work and is not attached to pleasant work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः
words: for one who has a body cannot
but whoever gives up the results of action
is said to have truly let go
verses.tr: No one who has a body can give up action completely. But whoever gives up the results of action is said to have truly let go.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्
भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित्
words: the result of action is of three kinds
it comes after death to those who have not let go
but never to those who have renounced
verses.tr: The result of action is of three kinds: unwanted, wanted and mixed. It comes after death to those who have not let go, but never to those who have renounced.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: learn from me these five causes
for the accomplishment of all actions
verses.tr: Learn from me, Arjuna, the five causes that the Sankhya teaching gives for the accomplishment of every action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्
words: and the fifth of these, providence
verses.tr: They are the body, the doer, the various senses, the different kinds of effort, and the fifth, providence.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः
words: whatever action a person begins with body, speech or mind
verses.tr: Whatever action a person begins with body, speech or mind, whether right or wrong, these five are its causes.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः
words: कर्तारम् आत्मानं केवलं तु यः पश्यति
whoever sees the Self alone as the doer
because the understanding is not trained
that foolish person does not see
verses.tr: This being so, whoever sees the Self alone as the doer has an untrained understanding. That foolish person does not see.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते
हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते
words: one who has no sense of “I am the doer”
even if he kills these people
does not kill and is not bound
verses.tr: One who is free from the sense of “I am the doer”, and whose understanding is not stained, does not kill and is not bound, even if he kills these people.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: knowledge, the thing known and the knower
are the three things that prompt action
the instrument, the act and the doer
are the three parts of action
verses.tr: Knowledge, the thing known and the knower are the three things that prompt action. The instrument, the act and the doer are the three parts of an action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः
words: are each of three kinds, according to the gunas
so it is taught in the teaching on the gunas
hear about these too, as they are
verses.tr: Knowledge, action and the doer are each of three kinds, according to the gunas. Hear about these too, as they are taught.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: सर्व-भूतेषु येन एकं भावम् अव्ययम् ईक्षते
by which one sees one unchanging reality in all beings
know that knowledge to be of goodness
verses.tr: The knowledge by which a person sees one unchanging reality in all beings, undivided among the divided, know to be of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्
words: but the knowledge that, because of their separateness
sees many different beings of different kinds
know that knowledge to be of passion
verses.tr: But the knowledge that sees many separate beings of different kinds in all creatures, know to be of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: यत् तु कृत्स्नवत् एकस्मिन् कार्ये सक्तम्
but that which clings to one small thing as if it were the whole
is said to be of dullness
verses.tr: And the knowledge that clings to one small thing as if it were everything, without reason, without grasp of the truth, and narrow, is said to be of dullness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: by one who does not seek the result
that action is said to be of goodness
verses.tr: An action that is required, and is done without attachment, without liking or dislike, by someone who does not seek its result, is said to be of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः
words: but action done by one who wants to satisfy desires
is said to be of passion
verses.tr: But an action done to satisfy desires, or out of ego, and with great strain, is said to be of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the consequences, the loss and the harm to others
and one's own ability, without regard for
action that is begun out of delusion
is said to be of dullness
verses.tr: An action begun out of delusion, with no thought for its consequences, the loss or harm it may cause, or one's own ability, is said to be of dullness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: such a doer is said to be of goodness
verses.tr: A doer who is free from attachment and from talk of “I”, full of steadiness and enthusiasm, and unchanged by success or failure, is said to be of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: eager for the results of action
such a doer is said to be of passion
verses.tr: A doer who is full of craving, eager for the results of action, greedy, harmful, impure and swayed by joy and sorrow is said to be of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते
words: such a doer is said to be of dullness
verses.tr: A doer who is undisciplined, crude, stubborn, deceitful, malicious, lazy, gloomy and always putting things off is said to be of dullness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the division of understanding and of steadiness
into three kinds according to the gunas, hear
as I explain it fully, one by one
verses.tr: Now hear, Arjuna, as I explain fully and one by one, the three kinds of understanding and of steadiness, according to the gunas.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये
बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी
words: when to act and when to hold back
what should and should not be done
what is to be feared and what is not
which knows what binds and what frees
verses.tr: The understanding that knows when to act and when to hold back, what should and should not be done, what is to be feared and what is not, what binds and what frees, Arjuna, is of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च
words: by which dharma and its opposite
and what should and should not be done
verses.tr: The understanding that has a mistaken idea of dharma and its opposite, and of what should and should not be done, Arjuna, is of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: which takes what is against dharma to be dharma
and sees all things the wrong way round
verses.tr: The understanding that is covered by darkness, takes what is against dharma to be dharma, and sees everything the wrong way round, Arjuna, is of dullness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the steadiness by which one holds
the workings of the mind, the breath and the senses
verses.tr: The unwavering steadiness by which a person holds the workings of the mind, the breath and the senses through yoga, Arjuna, is of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी
words: but the steadiness by which one holds on to
out of attachment, wanting the results
verses.tr: But the steadiness by which a person holds on to duty, pleasure and wealth out of attachment, wanting their rewards, Arjuna, is of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च
न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी
words: a foolish person does not let go of
verses.tr: And the steadiness by which a foolish person refuses to let go of sleep, fear, grief, gloom and arrogance, Arjuna, is of dullness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ
words: सुखं तु इदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे
now hear from me the three kinds of happiness
in which one comes to delight through practice
and reaches the end of sorrow
verses.tr: Now hear from me, Arjuna, the three kinds of happiness. The happiness in which a person comes to delight through long practice, and in which sorrow ends,

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: which is like poison at first
but like nectar in the end
that happiness is said to be of goodness
born of the clearness of one's own understanding
verses.tr: which is like poison at first but like nectar in the end, and which is born of a clear understanding of the Self: that happiness is said to be of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: from the contact of the senses with their objects
which is like nectar at first
but like poison in the end
that happiness is held to be of passion
verses.tr: The happiness that comes from the contact of the senses with their objects, which is like nectar at first but like poison in the end, is held to be of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: which at the beginning and at the end
is a happiness that deludes the self
arising from sleep, laziness and carelessness
is said to be of dullness
verses.tr: And the happiness that deludes a person from beginning to end, and comes from sleep, laziness and carelessness, is said to be of dullness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः
words: पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः
on earth, or in heaven among the gods
प्रकृति-जैः मुक्तं यत् एभिः स्यात् त्रिभिः गुणैः
that is free from these three gunas born of nature
verses.tr: There is no being on earth, or in heaven among the gods, that is free from these three gunas born of nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of brahmins, kshatriyas, vaishyas and shudras
according to the qualities born of their own nature
verses.tr: The duties of brahmins, kshatriyas, vaishyas and shudras, Arjuna, are divided according to the qualities born of their own nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: are the duties of a brahmin, born of his nature
verses.tr: Calmness, self-control, self-discipline, purity, patience, honesty, knowledge, direct experience and faith are the duties of a brahmin, born of his nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: are the duties of a kshatriya, born of his nature
verses.tr: Courage, vigour, steadiness, skill, not fleeing in battle, generosity and leadership are the duties of a kshatriya, born of his nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: farming, care of cows and trade
are the duties of a vaishya, born of his nature
is the duty of a shudra, born of his nature
verses.tr: Farming, the care of cows and trade are the duties of a vaishya, born of his nature. Work that consists of service is the duty of a shudra, born of his nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः
words: how one devoted to one's own work finds perfection
verses.tr: A person reaches perfection by being devoted to their own work. Hear how one who is devoted to their own work finds perfection.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: from whom all beings come forth
by whom all this is pervaded
worshipping him through one's own work
verses.tr: A person finds perfection by worshipping, through their own work, the one from whom all beings come forth and who fills all of this.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: better is one's own dharma, though imperfect
than the dharma of another well performed
doing the work set by one's own nature
verses.tr: It is better to do one's own duty imperfectly than to do another's duty well. One who does the work set by their own nature incurs no fault.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्
words: the work one is born to
one should not give up, even if it has faults
for all undertakings are covered by some fault
verses.tr: One should not give up the work one is born to, Arjuna, even if it has faults. Every undertaking is clouded by some fault, as fire is by smoke.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: with an understanding attached to nothing
the highest perfection of freedom from action
verses.tr: One whose understanding is attached to nothing, who is self-controlled and free from longing, reaches by renunciation the highest perfection of freedom from action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे
समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा
words: how one who has reached perfection reaches Brahman
which is the highest state of knowledge
verses.tr: Learn from me in brief, Arjuna, how one who has reached this perfection reaches Brahman, the highest state of knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च
words: giving up sound and the other objects of the senses
and putting aside liking and dislike
verses.tr: With a pure understanding, controlling oneself with steadiness, giving up sound and the other objects of the senses, and putting aside liking and dislike;

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: with speech, body and mind controlled
always devoted to the yoga of meditation
verses.tr: living in a quiet place, eating lightly, with speech, body and mind controlled, always devoted to the yoga of meditation and resting in detachment;

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्
words: one becomes fit to be one with Brahman
verses.tr: having given up ego, force, arrogance, desire, anger and possessiveness, free from the sense of “mine” and at peace: such a person becomes fit to be one with Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम्
words: one with Brahman, serene in heart
one gains the highest devotion to me
verses.tr: One with Brahman and serene in heart, that person neither grieves nor craves. The same to all beings, that person gains the highest devotion to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्
words: by devotion one comes to know me
how great I am and who I truly am
one enters into me at once
verses.tr: By devotion a person comes to know me, how great I am and who I truly am. Knowing me truly, that person enters into me at once.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: though always doing all kinds of work
verses.tr: Though always doing all kinds of work, one who takes refuge in me reaches, by my grace, the eternal and unchanging home.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: in your mind giving up all actions to me
relying on the yoga of understanding
keep your mind always on me
verses.tr: In your mind, offer all your actions to me and hold me as your highest goal. Relying on the yoga of understanding, keep your mind always on me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: you will cross all difficulties by my grace
अथ चेत् त्वम् अहङ्कारात् न श्रोष्यसि
but if, out of ego, you will not listen
verses.tr: With your mind on me, you will cross all difficulties by my grace. But if, out of ego, you will not listen, you will be lost.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: this resolve of yours is useless
verses.tr: If you give in to ego and think, “I will not fight”, your resolve is useless. Your own nature will compel you.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: bound by your own duty, born of your nature
what you do not wish to do, out of delusion
that you will do even against your will
verses.tr: Bound by your own duty, which is born of your nature, Arjuna, you will do, even against your will, the very thing that in your delusion you do not wish to do.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the Lord lives in the heart of all beings
as if mounted on a machine
verses.tr: The Lord lives in the heart of all beings, Arjuna, and by his maya makes them all turn, as if they were mounted on a machine.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: you will reach supreme peace and the eternal home
verses.tr: Take refuge in him alone, Arjuna, with your whole being. By his grace you will reach supreme peace and the eternal home.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: so I have told you this knowledge
verses.tr: So I have told you this knowledge, more secret than any secret. Think it over fully, and then do as you wish.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः
इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्
words: hear once more the most secret of all
because you are very dear to me
I shall tell you what is good for you
verses.tr: Hear once more my highest word, the most secret of all. You are very dear to me, and so I shall tell you what is good for you.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे
words: you will come to me alone
verses.tr: Fix your mind on me, be devoted to me, worship me and bow to me. You will come to me. I promise you this truly, for you are dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः
words: I shall free you from all wrongs
verses.tr: Give up all dharmas and take refuge in me alone. I shall free you from all wrongs. Do not grieve.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति
words: or who does not wish to hear
or who finds fault with me
verses.tr: You should never tell this to anyone who has no self-discipline or devotion, who does not wish to hear it, or who finds fault with me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: showing the highest devotion to me
will come to me without doubt
verses.tr: Whoever teaches this highest secret to my devotees shows the highest devotion to me, and will come to me without doubt.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि
words: does what is dearer to me than he
भविता न च मे तस्मात् अन्यः
verses.tr: No one among people does anything dearer to me than this, and no one on earth will ever be dearer to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः
words: by that person I shall be worshipped with the sacrifice of knowledge
verses.tr: And whoever studies this sacred conversation of ours will be worshipping me with the sacrifice of knowledge. That is my view.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: full of faith and not finding fault
the person who even just listens
and reaches the happy worlds of those who do good
verses.tr: Even a person who simply listens to it, with faith and without finding fault, is freed and reaches the happy worlds of those who do good.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: with a mind fixed on one point
has your delusion, born of ignorance, been destroyed
verses.tr: Arjuna, have you heard this with your full attention? Has your delusion, born of ignorance, been destroyed?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
words: I stand firm, my doubts gone
I shall do as you say
verses.tr: Arjuna said: My delusion is gone, Krishna, and by your grace I have recovered my understanding. I stand firm, my doubts are gone, and I shall do as you say.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
words: इति अहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः
so I, of Vasudeva (Krishna) and of the great-souled Partha (Arjuna)
wonderful, making the hair stand on end
verses.tr: Sanjaya said: So I heard this wonderful conversation between Krishna and the great-souled Arjuna, which makes my hair stand on end.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
words: by the grace of Vyasa I heard
from Krishna, the Lord of yoga
as he himself taught it directly
verses.tr: By the grace of Vyasa I heard this supreme secret, this yoga, directly from Krishna, the Lord of yoga, as he himself taught it.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.tr: O King, as I remember again and again this wonderful and sacred conversation between Krishna and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
skt: विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः
words: that most wonderful form of Hari (Krishna)
and I rejoice again and again
verses.tr: And as I remember again and again that most wonderful form of Hari, O King, my amazement is great, and I rejoice again and again.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
skt: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः
words: where there is Krishna, the Lord of yoga
and where there is Partha (Arjuna), the archer
there will be fortune, victory, well-being
verses.tr: Wherever there is Krishna, the Lord of yoga, and wherever there is Arjuna, the archer, there will surely be fortune, victory, well-being and right conduct. That is my belief.
